svg.aria-label: How background work starts on its own: heartbeats, Calendar tasks, chat loops and the task queue
svg.text: load cron/jobs.json, clear stale 'running' flags, next fire = now + interval
Heartbeats missed while down are not caught up and not
recorded: the countdown simply restarts from boot time
record each Calendar fire that came due while down as a 'missed' run; never replay it
Exception: a one-time task whose run had started when
the process died is run again (at-least-once)
load loops/jobs.json with a plain Start (not the crash-recovery start)
Each engine copy runs at most 8 jobs at once; a job
whose previous run is still going is skipped
Refuses if the owner agent is gone or is a worker; never
direct Go call, no message bus, no routing
save the prompt to the chat
Runs unattended (AutoDenyAsk). An ask that is still
unresolved after the Auto, rule and saved-grant checks
is refused, with no human wait; the run does not send
of that chat see it stream live
'schedule failed' notification + alert on the agent's default channel
Rate-limit / network / 5xx errors retry after 1, 2, then
save outcome, last 20 runs, next fire
due job: check the task still
SpawnTriggeredRun(task, occurrence), unattended (unresolved asks refused; no human wait)
Refuses if the task's plan is not running or a
dependency is not done. A MAIN-mode run goes to the
launcher (executeMainTask) before the slot limit is
checked; only other runs need a free slot of the task
dispatch limit and are refused when all slots are busy
claim task next -> in_progress; create its fresh
task conversation; open a run record
If the assignee has a main chat in the workspace (and
the task is not forced isolated), the run is started
instead as a fresh child conversation of that main chat
through the delegation launcher. This path is taken
before the task slot limit; the launcher's own admission
applies. Otherwise a fresh parentless isolated task
Repeating task: the next occurrence is armed now as a
new one-time job. One-time task: the job is kept until
when the run ends: 'Task run done/failed' notice into the starter's chat
every minute: CheckQueuedTasks, at most one 'next'
task per agent per pass, unattended (unresolved
/loop fire: ProcessScheduled(owner, that chat, loop prompt)
reply; self-paced mode reads 'LOOP_NEXT: <delay>' and books the next one-time job (15 min if missing)
run count and next job id into the chat's session meta; stop at the run cap (100)
